Name: Demon Lord Chemosh
Notes: #1232 (D 2026-11-08): the PvP arena's summoned boss - the hardest boss in the game at level 100, no companions, he covers all three enemy slots. Summoned when both arena demons have drunk 10 drops of blood (never during a PvP fight). The fight is a battle in the battle scene (the player picks moves or autoplays; the server opens and credits it, chemoshfight): a win awards no experience and no items; the first win unlocks Cosmetic_ID for the account and a repeat awards nothing. Move_N = Line:Slot:Name - the moves.csv row at stage 3, renamed. Grade_* are the 1-10 class grades; Quality_Mult multiplies Attack and Defense; HP is his max HP. Refight_Seconds: the server refuses a new fight sooner than this after the last one. Damage_Taken_Pct: his own 'takes N% less damage' share on every hit and on the end-of-round DoT tick (the engine floors it at 50%); his DoT-taken and his self-cleanse (Move_3) are what keep a %-max-HP DoT team from killing him in 6 rounds whatever his HP is (chmpolish 2026-11-11).
